parsed.explanation: The asserted infinite sunflower fact is false for families of unbounded finite sets; both counterexamples correctly demonstrate this, and the proposed induction need not terminate. Lemma 1 therefore is not proved, so the later conclusion that only finitely many terminal supports—and hence finitely many relevant primes—exist is unsupported. No independent bounded-size sunflower argument appears elsewhere. Repair requires replacing Lemma 1 with the bounded-cardinality version and proving it by induction on the size bound; this is a lemma-level repair.
